Name: Sweetry Buildings & Craftables
Author: KediDili
TagLine: A sweets themed buildings retexture mod. See the mod page and images for more info!
Description:
That's a sweets-themed buildings and craftables retexture mod that I've been working on for months, and finally releasing it. Some stuff might still be broken or might look weird even though I've tested and edited it lots of times.

It requires Alternative Textures (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246) and Content Patcher (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) mods or it'll not work.

~~Currently mobile incompatible, I have a mobile version under my hand but it needs to be tested by a mobile player and more fixes.~~

 Mobile version has been published together with the PC version of Sweetry! Firstly, I apologize for releasing the version without getting it tested, and hope that dear mobile players will let me know if they encounter any errors or bugs.

Buildings that aren't changed by this mod currently:
- ~~Well~~ (Added in 1.0.1!)
- ~~Island Farmhouse~~ (Added in 1.0.1!)
- Fish Well (From the Fish Well mod)
- ~~Silo~~ (Added in 1.0.1!)
- Gold Clock
- Shipping Bin
- Minecart Station (From the Extended Minecarts mod, I have made its sprite, though unfortunately this one's error isn't on my side so nothing I can do)

I want to add all of those to the main mod too, unless somebody else beats me to it!

If you run into an issue
- Upload your log to https://smapi.io/log and report it from the bugs section (Add a video/image if its a visual issue too!)

Check out my other mods! => https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/profile/225898
